english: A skeleton lies crumpled against the wall.
His armor has been stripped away.
Only scraps of leather and cloth remain.
You kneel down to inspect the skeleton.
The City Below claims many that way.
The skeleton lies where you left it.
The words flow. The magic takes hold.
The skull's jaw begins to move.
The dead man is ready to answer.
Five questions. That's all you get.
A simple name. For a simple life.
All named after a certain famous pirate (Johnny Longneck).
It was inside... those filthy goblins' stolen dwarven fortress...
We do not store some dragon trove in the Garden, nor the Roots, Cleric. I can promise you that.
At least he was already dead.
The dead man returns to silence.
That's all you'll get from him.
E-(Nod respectfully at the corpse, then leave.)
You're not seriously thinking about going after it?
Look how that worked out for this guy.
I'm more prepared than he was.
